CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.admitted(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if exists(select 1 from beta_private.owner_gameplay_control) and not beta_private.beta_gameplay_identity(p_user) then return false;end if;
 return beta_private.admitted_before_owner_gameplay(p_user);
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.beta_gameplay_identity(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 -- The original function retains its control-row locks and ordinary-member path.
 if beta_private.beta_gameplay_identity_before_delegated_admin(p_user) then return true;end if;
 perform 1 from beta_private.delegated_admin_admissions where user_id=p_user for share;
 return exists(select 1 from beta_private.delegated_admin_admissions g
  join beta_private.roles role on role.user_id=g.user_id and role.role='admin'
  join beta_private.friends_roster r on r.user_id=g.user_id and r.enabled
  join auth.users u on u.id=g.user_id and lower(u.email)=r.email
  where g.user_id=p_user and g.enabled
  and exists(select 1 from beta_private.friends_control where enabled)
  and beta_private.owner_gameplay_identity(g.approved_by)
  and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
  and coalesce(u.banned_until,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp());
 -- Identity permits normal authenticator enrolment. active_member_session and
 -- requireRole still require AAL2 before privileged gameplay or staff operations.
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.customer_signup_identity(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from beta_private.customer_invitations i join auth.users u on u.id=i.intended_user join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=u.id
 where u.id=p_user and i.account_bound_at is not null and i.revoked_at is null and lower(to_jsonb(u)->>'email')=i.email and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
 and a.status in('reserved','accepted') and (a.status='accepted' or i.expires_at>clock_timestamp()) and coalesce((to_jsonb(u)->>'banned_until')::timestamptz,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.gameplay_mfa_required(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=p_user)
 or exists(select 1 from beta_private.designated_administrators where user_id=p_user)
 or exists(select 1 from beta_private.owner_gameplay_control where owner_id=p_user)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.pending_beta_consent(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from beta_private.admissions a join auth.users u on u.id=a.user_id cross join beta_private.admission_control c
 where c.enabled and a.user_id=p_user and a.status='accepted' and a.country='AU' and a.age_attested
 and (a.policy_versions is distinct from c.policy_versions or a.policy_digest is distinct from c.policy_digest)
 and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
 and coalesce((to_jsonb(u)->>'banned_until')::timestamptz,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp()
 and beta_private.beta_gameplay_identity(p_user))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.profile_admission_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if not beta_private.admitted(new.id) then raise exception 'Accepted beta admission required';end if;
 if new.country<>'AU' or not new.age_attested or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.admissions a where a.user_id=new.id and a.state=new.state
 and a.policy_versions->>'terms'=new.accepted_version) then raise exception 'Beta eligibility or policy mismatch';end if;
 return new;
end$function$

constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'accepted'::text) OR ((accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (country = 'AU'::text) AND (state IS NOT NULL) AND age_attested AND (policy_digest IS NOT NULL))))
